responsibility: This file implements a simple stack abstraction for compiler support code on top of the Indexing dynamic index table. It owns the stack record and provides creation, destruction, push, pop, replace, depth, and indexed access operations for arbitrary addresses, aborting through M2RTS on underflow or out-of-range access, and serves as the generic stack utility used notably by parser passes that build and manipulate AST context.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file provides the concrete stack implementation, including the private stack record with an Indexing table and count field, allocation/deallocation, and runtime underflow or bounds checks via M2RTS. The same-stem header only exposes the opaque handle and function prototypes.
